name: withholding-tax-matrix
description: Use this 2026 cross-border withholding decision method before treating a services, royalty or interest payment as exempt or applying a treaty rate. It establishes payer, recipient, payment character, source, period and relief evidence, with sourced Canadian services, UK yearly-interest and US personal- services branches. It does not supply a verified worldwide treaty-rate matrix. The old matrices, country forms, corridors and examples remain a historical evidence archive and must not be used as current rates or filing instructions.
